records.source: Have you met everyone in town yet? That sounds exhausting.
records.translation: Nakilala mo na ba ang lahat sa bayan? Mukhang nakapapagod iyon.

records.source: Wow, look at these structures!$h#$b#I can tell they were made by a master builder. I'm really impressed!
records.translation: Wow, tingnan mo ang mga gusaling ito!$h#$b#Halatang ginawa ang mga ito ng dalubhasang tagapagtayo. Talagang hanga ako!

records.source: Wait a sec... you're giving me this? What a special treat! Thank you.
records.translation: Sandali... Ibinibigay mo ito sa akin? Napakanatatanging regalo! Salamat.

records.source: What's this... 'Woody's Secret'? ... Um, what kind of book is this, @?$6#$b#Oh, it's about woodcutting! Hahaha... Oh yeah, I'm going to love this. Thanks!$4
records.translation: Ano ito... “Lihim ni Woody”? ... Um, anong uri ng aklat ito, @?$6#$b#Ah, tungkol ito sa pagputol ng kahoy! Hahaha... Oo, magugustuhan ko ito. Salamat!$4

records.source: Ah, 'Woodcutter's Weekly'... I was hoping to get my hands on the newest issue! They've got all the latest techniques in here!#$b#From one woodcutter to another... Thank you.$h
records.translation: Ah, “Lingguhang Magtotroso”... Umaasa akong makuha ang pinakabagong labas! Narito ang lahat ng pinakabagong pamamaraan!#$b#Mula sa isang magtotroso para sa kapwa magtotroso... Salamat.$h

records.source: That man is insane! Why does he have to go out there? We have no idea if this rain is dangerous!$u%noturn
records.translation: Baliw ang lalaking iyon! Bakit kailangan niyang lumabas doon? Hindi natin alam kung mapanganib ang ulang ito!$u%noturn

records.source: I hope Demetrius is happy with the 'samples' he collected. Seems like his little science project is more important to him than his own wife. Hmmph.$6
records.translation: Sana masaya si Demetrius sa mga “sampol” na nakolekta niya. Mukhang mas mahalaga sa kaniya ang munting proyektong pang-agham kaysa sarili niyang asawa. Hmph.$6

records.source: There's all kinds of good wood out there today. Better get chopping, huh?
records.translation: Maraming uri ng magandang kahoy sa labas ngayon. Mabuting magsimula ka nang pumutol, ano?

records.source: Sebastian's back in the basement... what happened between you two?$s
records.translation: Bumalik si Sebastian sa silong... Ano ang nangyari sa inyong dalawa?$s

records.source: Maru was crying through the night... We're all devastated...$s
records.translation: Buong gabi umiyak si Maru... Labis kaming nasaktan...$s

records.source: Oh, don't worry... these are tears of joy. I know Sebastian will be very happy on %farm Farm!$h
records.translation: Ah, huwag kang mag-alala... luha ito ng kagalakan. Alam kong magiging napakasaya ni Sebastian sa Bukid na %farm!$h

records.source: We'll all miss having Maru around the house, but I'm sure we'll still see her often!
records.translation: Mami-miss naming lahat si Maru sa bahay, pero tiyak na madalas pa rin namin siyang makikita!

records.source: It was fun working on your house. That might be some of the finest construction I've ever done!$h#$e#I hope you're enjoying the new kitchen.
records.translation: Masayang magtrabaho sa bahay mo. Maaaring isa iyon sa pinakamagandang konstruksiyong nagawa ko!$h#$e#Sana nasisiyahan ka sa bagong kusina.

records.source: What are you going to do with all that new space in your house?#$e#Or perhaps I should call it... your 'mansion'?$h
records.translation: Ano ang gagawin mo sa lahat ng bagong espasyo sa bahay mo?#$e#O marahil dapat ko itong tawaging... “mansiyon” mo?$h

records.source: So, are you getting into the aged wine business? I've heard it's very lucrative... if you have the patience.
records.translation: Kaya, papasok ka ba sa negosyo ng pinatandang alak? Narinig kong malaki ang kita roon... kung matiyaga ka.

records.source: That's probably the sturdiest coop I've ever built. Hope you get a lot of use out of it!
records.translation: Marahil iyon ang pinakamatibay na Kulungang naitayo ko. Sana mapakinabangan mo iyon nang husto!

records.source: So, what are your plans with the new shed? The possibilities are endless!
records.translation: Kaya, ano ang plano mo sa bagong Bodega? Walang hanggan ang mga posibilidad!

records.source: How's that new coop treatin' ya? I'll be excited to meet your new animals!
records.translation: Kumusta ang bago mong Kulungan? Sabik akong makilala ang mga bago mong hayop!

records.source: Are you satisfied with the new barn? I'm sure you'll raise some very happy livestock in there!
records.translation: Nasiyahan ka ba sa bagong Kamalig? Tiyak na makapag-aalaga ka roon ng masasayang hayop!

records.source: *phew*... Building that slime hutch was a lot of work... I'll need a day at the spa to recuperate!$h
records.translation: *hay*... Napakaraming trabaho ang pagtatayo ng Bahay ng Slime... Kakailanganin ko ng isang araw sa spa upang makabawi!$h

records.source: So, have you been riding your new horse around town?#$b#I imagine you're pretty sore, but you'll get used to it soon.$h
records.translation: Kaya, sinasakyan mo na ba sa paligid ng bayan ang bago mong kabayo?#$b#Tiyak na masakit ang katawan mo, pero masasanay ka rin agad.$h

records.source: I mentioned to Willy that you got a new fish pond. He seemed really happy about it.#$e#Apparently, he raised crabs when he was a young man. Called it a 'time-honored tradition'.$h
records.translation: Nabanggit ko kay Willy na may bago kang Lawa ng Isda. Mukhang napakasaya niya dahil doon.#$e#Lumilitaw na nag-aalaga siya ng mga alimango noong binata pa. Tinawag niya itong “matagal nang iginagalang na tradisyon”.$h

records.source: That was fun!$h
records.translation: Masaya iyon!$h

records.source: Hey, look! I can see another island from here.
records.translation: Uy, tingnan mo! May nakikita akong isa pang isla mula rito.

records.source: Hey @. You know, I was just thinking about how far the town has come since you first moved here.#$b#You should really be proud of all you've done!$h
records.translation: Uy, @. Alam mo, iniisip ko lang kung gaano kalaki ang isinulong ng bayan mula nang lumipat ka rito.#$b#Dapat mo talagang ipagmalaki ang lahat ng nagawa mo!$h

records.source: This is so relaxing...
records.translation: Talagang nakapagpaparelaks dito...

records.source: Veggie salt? Sounds good, but I don't need it.
records.translation: Asin na gawa sa gulay? Mukhang masarap, pero hindi ko kailangan.

records.source: Hmm... when I think of flowers, I think of Evelyn. Maybe show this to her?
records.translation: Hmm... Kapag iniisip ko ang mga bulaklak, naiisip ko si Evelyn. Baka ipakita mo ito sa kaniya?

records.source: Our little plan worked out well, don't you think? Pam and Penny seem really happy.
records.translation: Nagtagumpay ang munting plano natin, hindi ba? Mukhang napakasaya nina Pam at Penny.

records.source: Our little plan worked out well, don't you think? Pam and Penny seem really happy.
records.translation: Nagtagumpay ang munting plano natin, hindi ba? Mukhang napakasaya nina Pam at Penny.

records.source: Ooh... Two tickets for tonight's show, huh? Sounds good! I'll meet you there.$h
records.translation: Ooh... Dalawang tiket para sa palabas ngayong gabi, ano? Maganda iyan! Magkita tayo roon.$h

records.source: Hey! I heard some weird noises last night, and woke up this morning to find the quarry bridge completely repaired!#$b#It's a miracle of woodworking!
records.translation: Uy! May narinig akong kakaibang ingay kagabi, at nang magising ako ngayong umaga, lubos nang naayos ang tulay ng tibagan!#$b#Himala iyon ng paggawa sa kahoy!

records.source: I knew it from the moment you stepped off that bus, @... you were destined to be a town hero!$h
records.translation: Alam ko mula nang bumaba ka sa bus na iyon, @... itinadhana kang maging bayani ng bayan!$h

records.source: Hey! I heard that Lewis showed you around the Community Center... It'd be great if you could fix that place up. It used to be a really nice building!
records.translation: Uy! Narinig kong inilibot ka ni Lewis sa Sentro ng Komunidad... Napakaganda kung maaayos mo ang lugar na iyon. Napakagandang gusali niyon noon!

records.source: Have I told you that I built our house from the ground up?#$e#It's definitely been the highlight of my career so far.
records.translation: Nasabi ko na ba sa iyong itinayo ko mula sa simula ang bahay namin?#$e#Tiyak na iyon ang pinakamahalagang nagawa ko sa aking karera hanggang ngayon.

records.source: Hey, if you need any materials or blueprints, my shop is the place you're looking for!#$e#Plus, your business supports the local economy.$h
records.translation: Uy, kung kailangan mo ng anumang materyales o plano, tindahan ko ang hinahanap mo!#$e#At sinusuportahan ng pagtangkilik mo ang lokal na ekonomiya.$h

records.source: Hey there, @.#$e#I was just daydreaming about some new carpentry projects.#$e#Are you doing OK at your place? How's the woodwork in your cottage holding up?
records.translation: Kumusta, @.#$e#Nangangarap lang ako nang gising tungkol sa ilang bagong proyekto sa pagkakarpintero.#$e#Ayos lang ba ang lahat sa tahanan mo? Matibay pa ba ang mga bahaging kahoy ng kubo mo?

records.source: You're always welcome to visit us, even if you aren't shopping, you know.$h#$e#It can get pretty lonely up here in the mountains.
records.translation: Palagi kang malugod na tinatanggap sa amin kahit hindi ka mamimili, alam mo.$h#$e#Maaaring maging malungkot dito sa kabundukan.

records.source: You've met my son Sebastian, right? He lives downstairs.#$e#He's a little shy, but I'm sure he'll warm up to you if you're nice to him.
records.translation: Nakilala mo na ang anak kong si Sebastian, hindi ba? Nakatira siya sa ibaba.#$e#Medyo mahiyain siya, pero tiyak na magiging palagay siya sa iyo kung mabait ka sa kaniya.

records.source: I miss my Sebby... he was always a little misunderstood, but I believed in him.
records.translation: Nami-miss ko ang Sebby ko... Madalas siyang hindi nauunawaan, pero naniwala ako sa kaniya.

records.source: #$1 RobinSeb#I found an ashtray in Sebastian's room, and it smelled really weird. Should I be worried about this?#$e#Sometimes I worry about Sebastian... he doesn't have many friends and doesn't really seem to care about his future very much...#$e#I would talk to him about it but he never opens up to me.
records.translation: #$1 RobinSeb#May nakita akong abuhan sa silid ni Sebastian at talagang kakaiba ang amoy. Dapat ba akong mag-alala rito?#$e#Minsan ay nag-aalala ako kay Sebastian... Wala siyang maraming kaibigan at tila wala siyang gaanong pakialam sa hinaharap niya...#$e#Kakausapin ko sana siya tungkol dito, pero hindi siya kailanman nagbubukas ng loob sa akin.

records.source: Sebastian told me he's trying to quit smoking! I'm really proud of him.
records.translation: Sinabi sa akin ni Sebastian na sinusubukan niyang tumigil sa paninigarilyo! Talagang ipinagmamalaki ko siya.

records.source: Our house is in such a beautiful area, don't you think?#$e#I love the fresh air of the mountains.
records.translation: Napakaganda ng lugar ng bahay namin, hindi ba?#$e#Gustong-gusto ko ang sariwang hangin ng kabundukan.

records.source: I hope Demetrius doesn't blow the house up with those science experiments of his.#$e#I'm not even sure what he's working on. I think it has something to do with plants.
records.translation: Sana hindi pasabugin ni Demetrius ang bahay sa mga eksperimento niya sa agham.#$e#Hindi ko nga tiyak kung ano ang ginagawa niya. Sa tingin ko, may kinalaman iyon sa mga halaman.

records.source: #$1 RobinDem#My husband almost set the house on fire last night with his science experiment. One of his beakers exploded and sent a fireball into the rafters! Thank Yoba I used fire-resistant lacquer when I built the place.$u#$e#Sorry if it smells weird in here, @. It's my husband's bizarre science project...
records.translation: #$1 RobinDem#Muntik nang sunugin ng asawa ko ang bahay kagabi dahil sa eksperimento niya sa agham. Sumabog ang isa sa kaniyang mga beaker at nagpakawala ng bolang apoy sa mga tahilan! Salamat kay Yoba at gumamit ako ng barnis na hindi madaling masunog noong itinayo ko ang lugar.$u#$e#Paumanhin kung kakaiba ang amoy dito, @. Kakaibang proyekto iyon sa agham ng asawa ko...

records.source: Hi @! It's good to see you.#$e#You're a regular member of the community now, don't you think?
records.translation: Kumusta, @! Masayang makita ka.#$e#Ganap ka nang bahagi ng komunidad ngayon, hindi ba?

records.source: Great, then this blueprint should be a piece of cake for you!$h
records.translation: Mahusay, kung gayon ay magiging napakadali para sa iyo ng planong ito!$h

records.source: Well, then I have the perfect blueprint to get you started!
records.translation: Aba, kung gayon ay mayroon akong perpektong plano upang makapagsimula ka!

records.source: Wood is a wonderful substance... it's versatile, cheap, strong, and each piece has its own unique character!
records.translation: Kahanga-hangang materyal ang kahoy... Marami itong gamit, mura, matibay, at may sariling natatanging katangian ang bawat piraso!

records.source: If you need any buildings on your farm upgraded, just ask me!#$e#You'll need to provide enough lumber and stone for the project. And it costs money, too.#$e#But I'm sure you'll be pleased with the results!$h
records.translation: Kung kailangan mong pahusayin ang anumang gusali sa bukid, tanungin mo lang ako!#$e#Kailangan mong magbigay ng sapat na kahoy at bato para sa proyekto. At may bayad din.#$e#Pero tiyak na masisiyahan ka sa resulta!$h

records.source: We're pretty insulated from the rest of the world here in Stardew Valley.#$e#It has its pros and cons.
records.translation: Medyo hiwalay tayo sa ibang bahagi ng mundo dito sa Stardew Valley.#$e#May mga pakinabang at kawalan iyon.

records.source: #$1 RobinMaru#Maru likes gems. She uses them in her inventions.#$e#So how are you and Maru getting along?
records.translation: #$1 RobinMaru#Mahilig si Maru sa mga hiyas. Ginagamit niya ang mga iyon sa mga imbensiyon niya.#$e#Kaya, kumusta ang samahan ninyong dalawa ni Maru?

records.source: You're always welcome to visit us, even if you aren't in the market for a building upgrade!$h#$e#It can get pretty lonely up here in the mountains.
records.translation: Palagi kang malugod na makadadalaw sa amin kahit hindi ka naghahanap ng pagpapahusay sa gusali!$h#$e#Maaaring maging malungkot dito sa kabundukan.

records.source: Have you met the wild man that lives behind our house?$s#$e#I guess I don't really mind, as long as he doesn't bother us.
records.translation: Nakilala mo na ba ang taong-gubat na nakatira sa likod ng bahay namin?$s#$e#Sa palagay ko ay ayos lang sa akin basta hindi niya kami inaabala.

records.source: Hey, it's a perfect time of year to gather wood.#$e#Maybe you can collect enough to upgrade your house!
records.translation: Uy, perpektong panahon ito ng taon upang mangalap ng kahoy.#$e#Baka makakolekta ka ng sapat upang pahusayin ang bahay mo!

records.source: My parents were bewildered when I told them I wanted to be a carpenter.#$e#They were pretty old-fashioned.
records.translation: Nagtaka ang mga magulang ko nang sabihin kong gusto kong maging karpintero.#$e#Medyo makaluma sila.

records.source: I think the farm life is really healthy for Sebby.
records.translation: Sa tingin ko, talagang nakabubuti sa kalusugan ni Sebby ang buhay sa bukid.

records.source: Our house is in such a beautiful area, don't you think?#$e#Everything looks still after a fresh snow.
records.translation: Napakaganda ng lugar ng bahay namin, hindi ba?#$e#Mukhang payapa ang lahat matapos ang sariwang pag-ulan ng niyebe.
